for root,dirs,files in os.walk('.'):
    dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in ('.git','.lake')]
    for f in sorted(files):
        if not f.endswith('.lean'): continue
        p=os.path.join(root,f)
        lines=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read().split('\n')
        depth=0; hits=[]
        for i,l in enumerate(lines):
            sd=depth; j=0
            while j < len(l)-1:
                if l[j:j+2]=='/-': depth+=1; j+=2; continue
                if l[j:j+2]=='-/': depth=max(0,depth-1); j+=2; continue
                j+=1
            if sd>0 or depth>0: continue
            code=l.split('--')[0]
            if pat.search(code): hits.append(i)
        if not hits: continue
        byd=collections.OrderedDict()
        for i in hits:
            j=i; name=kind=dl=None
            while j>=0:
                m=decl_re.match(lines[j])

            byd.setdefault((dl,kind,name),[]).append(i+1)
        print(f"=== {p}  [{len(byd)}]")
        for (dl,kind,name),bls in byd.items():
            print(f"    {dl}: {kind} {name}")
        grand+=len(byd)
print("TOTAL HasPicSchemeEt DECLS:", grand)

smooth, geometrically irreducible). -/
